div.div:
Key Data Flow:
1. External data ingested into GRQ
2. Trigger rules evaluate new data
3. Jobs submitted to Mozart
4. Mozart queues jobs in RabbitMQ
5. Verdi workers consume and execute
6. Results stored and metadata published

div.div:
Scale Capabilities:
• 8,200+ concurrent nodes tested
• 250K+ cores
• 3M+ jobs per day
• Spot instance support
• Multi-cloud deployment
• Auto-scaling based on demand

div.div:
Job Execution Flow:
1. Worker receives job from queue
2. Osaka localizes input data
3. Container runtime executes PGE
4. Output products generated
5. Osaka stages out results
6. Metadata published to GRQ
7. Status updated in Mozart
